Apple Vision vs ours

Ours is the fully portable stack: u2net (ONNX, Apache-2.0) detects the subject, its mask is snapped onto our region partition by per-region majority vote, and the result is stored in the file as a 96–168 byte selection chunk. No Apple code, no macOS requirement — the same weights run under onnxruntime-web in a browser.

Vision is the reference, not ground truth. There are no human-drawn masks for these six photographs, so the red panel shows where the two differ — not where ours is wrong. None of the disagreements were adjudicated.

Detection: u2net via rembg 2.0.77 and onnxruntime 1.28.0. Partition: this format's Potts / Mumford-Shah merge at 1,005–1,433 regions. Selection: SHPC v3 chunk, one instance id per region. Licences and their verification: LICENSES.md.

Not verified: whether the u2net.onnx that rembg redistributes is byte-identical to the upstream Apache-2.0 artefact. Unmeasured: onnxruntime-web inside an actual browser — these timings are native, with a CoreML provider available.
